system.traits: Divinity, Insight, Invested, Soul, Staff, Warding
system.description:
Usage held in 1 hand; Weight 4 lbs. Power Points 30; Recharge 3 per day.

Every previous bearer has carved a name somewhere upon the wood. New owners often find names they are certain they recognise but cannot explain why.

You gain a +2-item bonus to saving throws against magical effects that alter, suppress, erase or replace memory.

Activate Cast a Spell; Effect You expend the required PP to cast a spell from its list.

Craft Requirements Supply one casting of all listed spells at the indicated PP cost

Spells: Hallowed Rest (2 PP), Litany of Remembrance (6 PP), Restore Memory (12 PP).

On the sheet: a staff: its three spells are cast from the item's PP; +2 item is offered on saves against memory effects while it is held.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 11.

conditionals.label: Staff of Returning Memory
conditionals.scope: Saving throws against magical effects that alter, suppress, erase or replace memory
